visual_concept: Observe the family from a respectful distance, then narrow the frame only when private realization leaks through performance.
camera_grammar: camera movement requires a narrative reason
favor eye-level frames until a power change justifies a change
reaction can be more important than the speaker
performance_grammar: play objectives rather than emotion labels
keep outward behavior restrained and let emotion leak through eyes, breath and hands
editing_grammar: cut on information change or decision, not automatically at dialogue boundaries
sound_grammar: keep the room quiet enough that paper handling and breath carry emotional weight

scenes.dramatic_event: the daughter recognizes that her father is concealing what happened to the house papers
scenes.audience_know: the daughter does not believe the papers are merely stored elsewhere
scenes.audience_question: why is the father hiding it?

performance_notes.C01: test rather than accuse; hold eye contact, then glance to the receipt
performance_notes.C02: minimize the situation; fold the receipt too carefully and avoid eye contact

spatial_notes: keep both characters on consistent screen sides across coverage

scenes.cinematography_intent: start with readable two-person geography, then move into restrained reaction coverage when suspicion becomes visible
scenes.sound_intent: paper fold and room tone remain audible under dialogue
scenes.edit_intent: hold on the listener after the father's answer before cutting
